Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_Enabled_tooltip: When off, the minimap stays open without a watch and map watches don't drain.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_MinimapRule_too:
No watch needed: the minimap stays open.
Watch required: wear a map watch with charge.
Minimap off: nobody can open the minimap.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_FullHours_toolt: Real time, 1 to 720 hours: how long a full battery keeps a map watch running.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainOffline_to:
Off by default: the battery doesn't drain while the player is offline.
When on, the offline time is deducted on the next login (up to 30 days).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainPaused_too: Off by default: the battery doesn't drain while a single-player game is paused. Multiplayer servers don't pause.
